1722-2034-3583-6273.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6273.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

2403-2527-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-2527-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

969-2023-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-950-7287.easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

728-3951-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
728-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

849-1580-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

394-2438-3240-6462.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4268-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4268-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-907-1437-1993--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-907-1437-1993--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7330.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1292-3117-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4871-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

789-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

1778-2173-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

856-2173-5220-6798.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-5220-6798.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-5220-6798.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2173-4063-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

413-1349-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
413-1349-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
When the Dinosaur enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
When the Dinosaur enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1680-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2060-3054-6701-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-3054-6701-6797.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-3054-6701-6797.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

2825-5889.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
2825-5889.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Great Train Heist and casting the copy without paying its mana cost, and choosing to pay {2}{R} to select its first mode.
Resolve the copy of Great Train Heist, untapping all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase if it is currently a combat phase.
Repeat.

4336-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2061-2103-2239.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-2239.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

603-2921-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-2921-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1458-2364-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-2364-5864.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-4050-4772-5926.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {G}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
Put all but one Grist, Voracious Larva token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens enters the battlefield, they each trigger for each token created this way. Choose not to pay for any of the triggers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

2084-3543.notablePrerequisites: Your commander is on the battlefield.
2084-3543.description:
Activate your commander by paying {2}{U}, causing your commander to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate your commander by paying {1}{U}, shuffling your commander into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2249-4050-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-4050-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {1}.
When the Triskelavite dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.

1017-1656-4762-4971.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1656-4762-4971.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Niv-Mizzet's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

342-674-2948-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Initiates of the Ebon Hand and Syr Ginger.
Activate Syr Ginger by paying {0}, adding {B}.
Repeat step 3.

215-1770-1789-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-1770-1789-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Lathliss trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Lathliss triggers, creating two 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1926-4050-4963.notablePrerequisites:
"Bear" chosen with Species Specialist.
You have a way to draw a card.
1926-4050-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Draw a card, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token instead.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Bear token, adding {1}.
The Bear dies, triggering Species Specialist.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Resolve the Species Specialist trigger, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1124-2793-2829-3062-5089.manaNeeded: {4} on the first turn, with {9} available each subsequent turn
1124-2793-2829-3062-5089.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, and causes you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing any artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, revealing Ugin's Nexus from exile and putting it into your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.
